text:
Every local business has moments when the phone should ring.

An air con tech on the first stinker of summer. An accountant in late June. A dentist on a Sunday night when a tooth starts throbbing.

Work out when yours are, and make sure you're at the top of Google when they arrive.

Google citations are every place your business name, address and phone number appear online. Directories, industry associations, old listings you forgot about.

Google says it uses info from across the web, including directories, to judge how well known you are.

Make them all match.

Google Ads changes something every few weeks. Most of it won't touch a local business.

I read every update so my clients don't have to, and only act on the ones that move calls and bookings.

Here's how I decide what matters:
